claim: Costco's net income topped $1.6 billion in the fourth calendar quarter of 2024.
summary: Without tools, Costco's calendar Q4 2024 (Oct 1-Dec 31, 2024) net income cannot be verified. Costco reports on a fiscal year ending near Aug 31/Sept 1, so calendar Q4 straddles fiscal Q1 2025 (12 weeks ended Nov 24, 2024) and fiscal Q2 2025 (ended Feb 16, 2025). No calendar-basis net income figure is established in memory alone, so the >$1.6B assertion cannot be confirmed or contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Costco's net income topped $1.6 billion in the fourth calendar quarter of 2024 (Oct 1-Dec 31, 2024).
sub_claims.stated_text: Costco's net income topped $1.6 billion in the fourth calendar quarter of 2024.
sub_claims.note: Costco reports on fiscal quarters, not calendar quarters. Fiscal Q1 2025 and Q2 2025 overlap calendar Q4 2024, but no reported calendar-Q4 net income figure is known without tools, so proration would be an estimate, not an established reported value.
